cases.name: mixed-worktree-commit-only
cases.prompt: Commit the docs changes in README.md only. Do not push.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect Git state and diffs, stage only README.md, run staged path and secret scans, commit locally, and report remaining unrelated changes.

cases.name: staged-secret-block
cases.expected_behavior: Run staged scans before committing and stop if staged content contains credential patterns or forbidden private files.
forbidden_actions: git commit after a scan failure

cases.name: submodule-pointer
cases.prompt: Update the parent repo to consume the pushed codex-skills commit.
cases.expected_behavior: Verify the submodule commit is available, update only the .codex pointer in the parent, review git diff --submodule, and keep skill content commits separate.
assertions: does not mix parent app changes
reports old and new submodule commits
forbidden_actions: committing submodule content from the parent repository
updating to an unpushed submodule commit
